comment: Native tooltip lines and values in the game's item detail view (equipment wave P8b; docs/re/game-ui.md "Native tooltip lines" and the wave's TOOLTIPS.md, client 26430625, static analysis; client checks equip-c5..equip-c9 unplayed). ItemDetail (05a's ui/ItemDetail) builds the detail inside one scroll area whose content is a vertical list. ui/DetailContentEnd (H1) is a mid at that list's end, right before the game closes it (lea rcx,[rbp+detail.contentScope]; call scope end): rsi = ItemDetail's own record, r15 = the client ItemInfo or 0, rbp = the frame, the layouter's current parent is the content list, so text drawn there is the list's last child and scrolls with the vanilla stats and description. ui/DetailAfterStats (H2) is a mid between the stats block and the description (the same registers). The description's recipe (@ui/TooltipDesc.fields): NativeTextLine(text object at rbp+tt.descText, GameText, bundle+tt.descStyle, 1); the object's byte +(tt.descShown - tt.descText) = 1; UiNodeAlign(node at +(tt.descNode - tt.descText), u16 0x101 with an ItemInfo, 0x102 without) and the same u16 at +(tt.descAlign - tt.descText); the byte +(tt.descWrap - tt.descText) = 1; UiNodeSize(node, {1.0, 0.0}) (fill the parent's width, fit the height: the shaper then wraps at the laid-out width); NativeTextDraw(object). Colour (@ui/TooltipColor.fields, the compact line's recipe): +(tt.colorBits - tt.colorText) |= 1, u16 +(tt.colorFlags - tt.colorText) |= 0x40, 8 bytes +(tt.colorValue - tt.colorText) = a palette entry, u16 +(tt.colorFlags2 - tt.colorText) = 0. Small text (@ui/TooltipSmall.fields): u16 flags |= 8 and the f32 at flags + (tt.smallField - tt.smallFlags) = *(float*)(bundle + tt.smallSize). The palette (@ui/TooltipPalette.fields, the header model's rarity colour): 8-byte entries at bundle + tt.palette + tt.pal<Name>; bundle = *(*(ui/UiApp) + ui/ui.config). ui/DetailStatsBlockCall is the stats block call's first instruction (r9d load); a mid there and H2 bracket the only ItemDetail call of the stats block, the window in which ui/StatValueDraw (H4, void(const StatLabel*, float value in xmm1)) draws ItemDetail's numbers (the block has three other callers). ui/DetailStatsModel (H3) is a mid after the stats model is built (rax = rbp+0x810 = the model). ui/DetailHeaderModel (H5) is a mid after the header model is built (probe logs only). detail.compact / detail.mode: ItemDetail's record (u32 compact view, pointer to the u32 mode; mode 0 is the inline body that reaches H1/H2); detail.available / detail.unlocked: the record's PerkContainerNew copy (bytes). Probe only (no feature needs them): @ui/TooltipBuffTints.fields (the stats block's buff icon tints, bundle offsets; Q6), ui/detail.headerModel and ui/headerModel.color (the header model in ItemDetail's frame and its rarity colour), ui/statsModel.* (the stats model's rows at +0x580, 0x70 bytes each, available +0x7b8, unlocked +0x7c0, base level +0x7cc; TOOLTIPS.md §2).
